card.name: Word before a from-to range
card.fires_on: The word "severity" in the standard C. difficile diarrhea warning, "may range in severity from mild diarrhea to fatal colitis". Also a word like "mixed" where a split of two outcomes is about to be given.

modes.label: Range in severity
modes.description: "severity" right after "may range in" in the antibiotic colitis warning, just before "from mild ... to fatal".
modes.example: and may range in<< severity>> from mild diarrhea to fatal colitis.

modes.label: Mixed results
modes.description: "mixed" in general text, where positive and negative effects are about to be laid out.
modes.example: have been clearly<< mixed>>. On the positive side, many students

card.writes: It promotes "either" and "depending", which fits a word that opens a two-sided or varying statement.
card.plain: It fires on a word that says outcomes vary, right before the text lists the different possibilities.
